d: Namaste, with the electric avatar, the Tata Sierra family is now complete. One is now spoilt for choice, as two Petrol, one diesel, and one electric version are on sale. Sierra electric isn’t a born EV platform, but it still packs a lot of firsts, like reaching that practical 500-kilometer range mark. I drove the new Tata Sierra electric extensively to test its range and better understand other aspects, and here are my impressions.
